title: Zesty Juicy Filipino Taro Ginataang Bilo Bilo
description: A traditional Filipino brunch dish featuring taro and chewy bilo bilo in a rich and creamy coconut milk sauce, topped with chopped chives for added freshness and flavor. This dish is a perfect blend of umami and juicy textures.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the cubed taro and enough water to cover, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium and simmer the taro for 15 minutes, or until it is tender when pierced with a fork.
In a separate pot, combine the coconut milk, pandan extract if using, and salt, then bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the cooked taro to the coconut milk mixture and stir to combine.
Add the bilo bilo to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, until they are cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the ginataang bilo bilo to a serving dish and top with chopped chives.
Serve the dish warm, garnished with additional chives if desired.
